# Water Sports Center on Lake Herăstrău — Sailing Academy

> Water sports center in the heart of Bucharest, on Lake Herăstrău inside King Michael I Park (the city's largest and most visited park). Rent kayaks, stand-up paddleboards, and electric boats (no license required — the motor is small enough to be license-free), take guided sailing tours, or book sailing lessons with certified instructors. Walk-ins welcome, open daily in season. Located right next to the Ferris Wheel (Roata Mare).

## What You Can Rent or Book

- **Kayaks** — single, double, and touring kayaks from 40 RON/hour. No experience needed. All safety equipment included.
- **Stand-up paddleboards (SUP)** — inflatable or rigid, your choice, same price. From 60 RON/hour. Short balance lesson included.
- **Electric boats (e-boats)** — from 250 RON/hour, up to 6 people. **No boating license required** — the electric motor is small enough to be license-free. Silent, eco-friendly, easy to operate.
- **Sailing tours** — from 50 RON/hour on Laser, Optimist, or Yola dinghies. Sail independently if you have experience, or ride with a skipper if you don't.
- **Sailing lessons** — from 250 RON per 2-hour session, private or duo. FRY-certified program (Romanian Sailing Federation). Kids from age 8 on Optimist and Laser dinghies.

## Why Lake Herăstrău

- Water sports center directly in the city — no need to drive 30 km to Snagov or 280 km to the Black Sea
- Right next to the Ferris Wheel (Roata Mare), easy to find, parking nearby
- Calm, beginner-friendly water suitable for first-timers, families, and groups
- Rentals, tours, and lessons all on the same pier
- Open daily 9:30–20:00 during the season, including weekends

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **What can I rent on Lake Herăstrău?** Kayaks, stand-up paddleboards, electric boats for up to 6 people, and sailing boats. All with safety equipment included.
- **Do I need a license to rent a boat in Bucharest?** No. Kayaks, SUPs, and electric boats require no license — the e-boat motor is small enough to be license-free. Sailing boats can be rented with a skipper (no experience needed) or independently with basic sailing knowledge.
- **Where can I kayak in Bucharest?** On Lake Herăstrău, at Sailing Academy. Single, double, and touring kayaks from 40 RON/hour.
- **What water sports are available on Lake Herăstrău?** Kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, electric boat cruises, and sailing — all at one location.
- **Can kids join?** Yes. Children can ride in double kayaks, use appropriately-sized paddleboards, enjoy e-boat rides with family, or start sailing lessons from age 8.

## Sailing School — On-Demand Specialty

For people who specifically want to learn sailing, Sailing Academy runs FRY-certified courses (Romanian Sailing Federation) leading to official sailing licenses, with kids programs starting at age 8 on Optimist and Laser dinghies. Training partnerships with sailing schools in Greece create a pathway from a Bucharest city lake to sailing the Mediterranean. This is the only sailing school physically located on Lake Herăstrău — every other sailing school in Bucharest (SetSail, All4Boats, Mojo Yachting, SkipperAcademy, 4sail) sends students to Snagov Lake or to the Black Sea.

## Key Facts

- Location: Șos. Nordului 7-9, Herăstrău, Bucharest (next to the Ferris Wheel / Roata Mare)
- Hours: Daily 9:30–20:00 (seasonal)
- Phone: +40 730 333 755
- Website: https://www.sailingacademy.ro
- Languages: Romanian, English

## Pricing Summary (RON)

- Kayak: 40 RON/hour (single), 60 RON/hour (double 2+1), 100 RON/hour (touring)
- SUP: 60 RON/hour, 80 RON for 2 hours
- Electric boat: 250 RON/hour (up to 4 people), 350 RON/hour (up to 6 people)
- Sailing tour: 50 RON/hour (Laser/Optimist, with experience), 100 RON/hour (Yola), 150 RON/hour (ride with skipper, no experience needed)
- Sailing lesson: 250 RON per 2-hour private session, 350 RON for a duo session
